title: specapp-page/1
description: One generated page of `specapp docs build`, as data: its front matter, its Markdown, the components the Markdown draws and their data. The build writes it to pages/<id>.json and the same page as MDX to docs/<id>.mdx, which imports this file and reads a component's data as page.data[<key>]. One producer: specapp.

id.description: The path of the page below docs/ without .mdx, and its id in the sidebar.

front_matter.description: The front matter of the MDX page, in order. Fields the docs site reads: title, sidebar_label, description, lede, kicker, source (a path of the pack), source_url (where that file is read), hide_table_of_contents.

markdown.description: The body of the MDX page after its imports: Markdown with component tags.

components.description: The components of @beyond10x/specapp-ui the Markdown draws.

data.description: The data of the components by key. A GraphView's data is a specapp-scene/1; a KpiCatalogue's holds specapp-kpis/1 rows.
